children: On August 5, 2026, after the market closed, Honeywell Aerospace reported a 70% year-over-year decline in second-quarter net income and reduced its full-year guidance. During the accompanying earnings call, management disclosed that its supply base had not increased production as expected and that a small group of constrained suppliers had a disproportionate impact on growth.
Following this news, the price of Honeywell Aerospace stock fell $47.17 per share, or 23.16%, to close at $156.47 per share on August 6, 2026.

On September 1, 2026, the Justice Department announced that Honeywell Aerospace agreed to pay $2,042,518 to resolve allegations that it violated the False Claims Act by failing to comply with cybersecurity requirements under a Defense Department contract. The settlement concerned alleged noncompliance by a business unit from April 2020 through December 2023.
Following this news, the price of Honeywell Aerospace stock fell $3.87 per share, or 2.45%, to close at $154.24 per share on September 1, 2026.
